# Bad Triggers Examples
# Demonstrates CK3101, CK3102, CK3870, CK3871, CK3872, CK3873, CK3875, CK3976, CK3977, CK5137, CK5142

namespace = semantic_bad_triggers

# ERROR CK3101: Unknown trigger
semantic_bad_triggers.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0001.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_super_powerful = yes # ERROR CK3101: Unknown trigger
		has_magic_powers = yes # ERROR CK3101: Unknown trigger
		can_fly = yes # ERROR CK3101: Unknown trigger
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0001.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3102 / CK3870: Effect used in trigger block
semantic_bad_triggers.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0002.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		add_gold = 100 # ERROR CK3102: Effect in trigger block
		add_prestige = 50 # ERROR CK3102: Effect in trigger block
		save_scope_as = actor # ERROR CK3102: Effect in trigger block
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0002.a
		add_piety = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3871: Effect in limit block
semantic_bad_triggers.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0003.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
				add_gold = 10 # ERROR CK3871: Effect in limit block (should be trigger only)
			}
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0003.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3872: Redundant always=yes trigger
semantic_bad_triggers.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0004.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		always = yes # ERROR CK3872: Redundant - event will always trigger
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0004.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3873: Impossible always=no trigger
semantic_bad_triggers.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0005.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0005.desc

	trigger = {
		always = no # ERROR CK3873: Event will never trigger
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0005.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3875: random_ without limit
semantic_bad_triggers.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0006.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0006.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# ERROR CK3875: random_ should have limit to narrow selection
		random_vassal = {
			add_gold = 100
		}

		# ERROR CK3875: No limit - will pick any courtier
		random_courtier = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0006.a
		add_gold = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3976: Effect in any_ iterator (trigger-only context)
semantic_bad_triggers.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0007.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0007.desc

	trigger = {
		# any_ is for checking conditions, not executing effects
		any_vassal = {
			add_gold = 10 # ERROR CK3976: Effect in any_ iterator (should use every_ in immediate/option)
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0007.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3977: every_ without limit (affects ALL entries)
semantic_bad_triggers.0008 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0008.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0008.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# ERROR CK3977: No limit - affects every single vassal (might be unintended)
		every_vassal = {
			add_gold = 100
		}

		# ERROR CK3977: No limit - affects every single courtier
		every_courtier = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0008.a
		add_gold = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK5137: is_alive without exists check (can crash)
semantic_bad_triggers.0009 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0009.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0009.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK5137: Should check 'exists' before 'is_alive' to prevent crashes
		father = {
			is_alive = yes # Can crash if father is null
		}

		# ERROR CK5137: Missing exists check
		liege = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_ruler = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0009.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK5142: Character comparison with = instead of this
semantic_bad_triggers.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0010.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0010.desc

	trigger = {
		# ERROR CK5142: Use 'this = root' not '= root' for character comparison
		liege = root # Wrong syntax for character comparison

		# ERROR CK5142: Should use 'this = scope:actor'
		any_vassal = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = vassal
			# Wrong: trying to compare character directly
			scope:vassal = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0010.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Multiple errors combined
semantic_bad_triggers.0011 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0011.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0011.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		has_super_trait = brave # ERROR CK3101: Unknown trigger
		father = {
			is_alive = yes # ERROR CK5137: Missing exists check
		}
		add_gold = 50 # ERROR CK3102: Effect in trigger block
	}

	immediate = {
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
				save_scope_as = temp # ERROR CK3871: Effect in limit block
			}
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0011.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3101 + CK3102: Combined unknown triggers and effects in trigger
semantic_bad_triggers.0012 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0012.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0012.desc

	trigger = {
		is_mega_ruler = yes # ERROR CK3101: Unknown trigger
		has_flying_ability = yes # ERROR CK3101: Unknown trigger
		trigger_event = semantic_bad_triggers.0013 # ERROR CK3102: Effect in trigger
		remove_trait = lazy # ERROR CK3102: Effect in trigger
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0012.a
		add_prestige = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3005: Logical operator not followed by block
semantic_bad_triggers.0013 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0013.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0013.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		# ERROR CK3005: NOT requires a block value { ... }
		NOT = yes
		# ERROR CK3005: OR requires a block value { ... }
		OR = yes
		# ERROR CK3005: AND requires a block value { ... }
		AND = no
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0013.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3007: Empty block with no children
semantic_bad_triggers.0014 = {
	type = character_event
	title = semantic_bad_triggers.0014.t
	desc = semantic_bad_triggers.0014.desc

	trigger = {
		# ERROR CK3007: Empty trigger block
	}

	immediate = {
		# ERROR CK3007: Empty immediate block
	}

	option = {
		name = semantic_bad_triggers.0014.a
		# ERROR CK3007: Empty option (only has name, no effects)
	}
}
